errors.text_span: Индекса на цените на потребителските стоки (ИЦН, също с база EC28=100)
errors.evidence: The y-axis label is "ИЦН, ЕС28=100". In the context of price convergence analysis (as suggested by the paper's title), ИЦН stands for "Индекс на ценови нива" (Price Level Index), not "Индекс на цените на потребителските стоки" (Consumer Price Index). While related, these are distinct economic indicators.

errors.text_span: България започва с най-ниски стойности — около 25 по оста X и 20 по оста Y
errors.evidence: The blue line for Bulgaria starts at approximately Y=31, not Y=20. The stated Y-value is significantly incorrect.

errors.text_span: и завършва със стойности около 43 по оста X и 27 по оста Y
errors.evidence: The blue line for Bulgaria ends at an X-value of approximately 52.4 and a Y-value of approximately 51.8 (based on the label). The stated end coordinates (43, 27) are completely wrong and correspond to a point from an earlier part of the trajectory.
The label "68,9; 52,2" corresponds to the end point of the orange line (Romania), not the gray line (Croatia).

errors.text_span: която преминава през началото на координатната система
errors.evidence: The diagonal line passes through the point (20, 20), which is the origin of the visible chart area, but not the origin of the coordinate system (0, 0).

errors.text_span: която представлява равенство между БВП на човек и ИЦН (т.е. пълна ценова конвергенция)
errors.evidence: Explaining the economic meaning of the diagonal line as 'full price convergence' is an interpretation that goes beyond describing the visual content of the chart.
